overview: The Medford Charter Study Committee voted to permit research into city council budget authority, tabled a motion on creating a public participation subcommittee, and approved sending draft charter Articles 2 and 3 to the Collins Center. The committee also received a presentation from the School Committee subcommittee on proposed draft language for Article 4.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the April 4, 2024 meeting.

items.title: City Council Budget Authority Research
items.summary: Approved a motion allowing Jean Zotter to research municipal budget reallocation powers and present findings to the budget subcommittee.

items.title: Public Participation Subcommittee Proposal
items.summary: Tabled a proposal to establish a public participation subcommittee until the next meeting after a roll call vote resulted in a tie.

items.title: Review of Charter Articles 2 and 3
items.summary: Approved sending draft text for Articles 2 and 3 to the Collins Center for review, incorporating amendments regarding council support staff funding and council confirmation of acting mayor appointments.

items.title: School Committee Subcommittee Report on Article 4
items.summary: Presented proposed draft language for Article 4, recommending a seven-member School Committee comprising four combined-ward members, two at-large members, and the mayor serving as chair.
